reviewed_by: Codex focused review for ripgrep workspace text search
reason: Seven collected Python cases cover the Core search route, symlink confinement, directory exclusions, descriptor bounds, ripgrep/Python parity, process failure fallback, result-limit counts, and the small-file threshold. Eight collected real-Core browser entries cover production Code search at desktop and emulated mobile widths on a LAN origin.
exclusions: No frontend source or native behavior changed. Unrelated Python and browser suites are excluded. Physical-device testing is unavailable; the permanent mobile Playwright profiles provide emulation evidence only.
